decision: held: 34798267 (Pharmacol Res 2022 meta-analysis, 19 trials), the only pooled source for the cardiovascular claim, has no open-access full text, so included trials, doses and forms cannot be verified; the one verifiable RCT (33671310, Enovita) has a null primary outcome and is approved without credit. Downgrading to reference is not justified while the meta-analysis (DBP reduction in abstract) is unverified.
summary: Enovita RCT (33671310): 80 adults with mildly elevated BP, 300 mg/day for 16 weeks, primary home SBP change not different from placebo (p=0.7197), DBP p=0.2001; positive only in a men-only analysis. The 2022 meta-analysis abstract reports DBP -2.20 mmHg and no significant SBP effect, but its methods cannot be verified. The record stays held; NCT registry entries are not PubMed sources and were not assessed.

identity.standardization: White-wine grape seed water extract standardized to >=95.0% OPCs (spectrophotometry); 5-10% monomeric catechin/epicatechin

population.description: 80 healthy adults aged 40-70 (45 men, 35 postmenopausal women) with mildly elevated systolic BP 125-140 mmHg on 7-day run-in and no pharmacological treatment; 78 in ITT analysis.

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled parallel-group trial (DRKS00011745), stratified by sex; separate in vitro HUVEC experiments not used.

outcomes.name: Primary: change in 7-day home mean systolic BP baseline to 16 weeks, GSEe vs placebo: no significant difference (p=0.7197)
Diastolic BP vs placebo: no significant difference (p=0.2001)
Men-only post hoc after a gender-by-product interaction: SBP -4.6 mmHg (95% CI -6.9 to -2.3), DBP -3.2 mmHg (-5.1 to -1.4) at 16 weeks
Perceived stress (PSQ) worries domain reduced in GSEe group (p=0.0199); additional objective

limitations: Whole-cohort primary and secondary BP results were null; the positive men-only analysis followed an interaction finding and cannot replace the primary result.
Exact Enovita material only; not transferable to all grape seed extracts.
No assigned co-therapy; pharmacological BP treatment excluded at entry.
Not scoring eligible: a single branded null-primary trial cannot carry the generic record's cardiovascular claim while the pooled meta-analysis (34798267) remains unverified.
Returned decision A073: source-content hold; methods now verified for 33671310 only.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

dose.administration_frequency: One 150 mg tablet 5-10 min before breakfast and one 5-10 min before lunch, daily.
dose.reported_regimen: Two 150 mg GSEe film-coated tablets daily (300 mg/day) for 16 weeks; matching placebo tablets.

normalization.basis: Two tablets x 150 mg Enovita extract = 300 mg/day of assigned material; not a marker conversion.

source_provenance.location: Methods 2.1 (extract), 2.2 (tablets), 2.4 study design, population, intervention and objectives; Results 3.2 (flow, primary endpoint p=0.7197, gender analysis), Table 3
